name: Perilla oil
description: Perilla oil (CAS 68153-38-8 ), also supplied under the trade name Dertoline DEG 2, is a specialty ester derived from resin acids and diethylene glycol. It functions as an antioxidant, stabilizer, and moisturizing agent across food, personal care, pharmaceutical, and agricultural applications. In food and nutraceutical formulations, it is incorporated as a functional lipid ingredient, valued for its stabilizing contribution to finished products. Personal care formulators use it as a humectant and skin-conditioning component in creams and serums. It is frequently utilized in emollient-rich topical preparations to improve texture and moisture retention. In pharmaceutical manufacturing, it supports formulation stability and acts as a carrier or excipient in soft-gel and liquid dosage forms. Agricultural and feed applications leverage its antioxidant properties to protect active ingredients. This helps to extend the shelf life of formulated products and ensures the integrity of the chemical composition over time. The product is available as a liquid oil, typically supplied in drums or intermediate bulk containers suited to industrial procurement volumes. Food-grade and technical-grade designations are the most commonly encountered specifications. Buyers should confirm grade suitability and applicable quality standards with the supplier based on end-use requirements.
